messages:
Arjun Shah: FYI were starting a GitHub org consolidation next month. Aim: merge infra-repos + platform-repos into a single org (redwood-core) to simplify permissions and apps. Kickoff doc: https://internal.redwood/migrations/github-org-consolidation-2026. Please comment on repos you own.

Nina Gomez: Important: this will change repo slugs and webhook endpoints. Any external integrations that rely on repo full_name will break unless we provide redirects. Do we have a plan for repo-level redirects?

Arjun Shah: Good call. GitHub provides repo redirect support when transferring to a new org if the name stays the same; but since many teams rename during cleanup, we'll create a temporary proxy mapping service for webhook URLs. We'll also publish a migration map CSV.

dev-bot: preflight checks: org-membership-sync -> PASS, app-permissions-check -> WARNING (2 repos with legacy GitHub Apps). See /debug/app-legacy-list.

Riley Park: Those 2 repos use the old 'redwood-legacy-deployer' GitHub App. Owners need to replace it with the new 'redwood-ci-integration' app and accept the org-level install. We can automate invites with the GH API: 
```
# sample invite flow
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: token $TOKEN" \
  https://api.github.com/orgs/redwood-core/outside_collaborators --data '{"username":"service-bot"}'
```

Tasha Morgan: Can we preserve issue/PR numbers? Teams care about historic links.

Arjun Shah: GitHub preserves issue/PR numbers when transferring repos between orgs (as long as we don't fork/recreate). We'll avoid repos that require renames until after transfer. Any repo that needs a rename will get a support ticket to set up 301 redirects for external docs.

Nina Gomez: CI note: GitHub Actions runners configured with org-level policies will need the new org slug. We'll update the runner registration command in the infra repo. Also: webhook secret rotation will run during cutover.

dev-bot: scheduled migration window draft: Sat Apr 24 01:00-05:00 UTC. Will run in batches of 50 repos with health checks in between.

Riley Park: We should also rotate personal access tokens used by automation. I'll publish a script to detect tokens in repo secrets and flag stale ones.

Tasha Morgan: Product/Support heads-up: customers with deep links to repo URLs (in-app docs) may encounter redirects. I'll prepare a status page blurb and a canned support reply.

Arjun Shah: Next steps: owners, please fill the migration survey in the doc by EOD Fri. We'll hold office hours Wed 16:00 UTC. If anyone runs into repo permission anomalies during tests, tag @oncall-platform. :rocket:
